description: This file defines a Java interface 'MessageCommand' in the package 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.messages'. It serves as a base interface for commands related to sending messages to things and features within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The interface includes methods for retrieving message details, resource paths, and associated headers, and it also defines nested classes for JSON field definitions used in serialization.

classes.name: MessageCommand.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains JSON field definitions for serializing/deserializing components of the MessageCommand such as thingId, message, headers, and payload.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the Message object to be delivered.

methods.name: getTypePrefix
methods.description: Returns the type prefix of message commands, defaulting to 'messages.' concatenated with a type qualifier.

methods.name: getMessageType
methods.description: Gets the type of the message to be delivered, used as a routing key for AMQP.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Retrieves the thing ID associated with the command.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type string, which is 'message'.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Sets the DittoHeaders for the command.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Constructs and returns the JSON Pointer path for the message resource based on message direction, subject, and optional feature ID.
